item.text:
The report now documents twenty reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F20: `Learner.syncWithLeader` dereferences a missing proposal for `COMMIT` after a `TRUNC`**. On the TRUNC sync path, `writeToTxnLog` remains false, so the COMMIT branch calls `pif.hdr.getZxid()` with a null `pif`. The repro observed:

```
WARN ... Truncating log to get in sync with the leader 0x0
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot read field "hdr" because "pif" is null
  at org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.Learner.syncWithLeader(Learner.java:673)
AssertionError: syncWithLeader dereferenced a missing proposal for COMMIT
```

Reproduction: [SyncCommitEmptyRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/sync_commit_empty/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/SyncCommitEmptyRepro.java).

F20 is separate from F19’s `COMMITANDACTIVATE` branch. The earlier nineteen findings remain documented, and the focused and integration test runs all passed for their selected suites. All reproduction files and observed outputs remain under `repro/`; the captured source was not modified.
